dct_description_sm: Raw X-ray fluorescence core scanning (XRF-CS) data of sediment core LLEs22-3 retrieved from Lake Los Espinos in April 2022. Scans were performed with a 500 µm step size and 10 seconds dwell time. The analysis yielded the ratio of Compton (incoherent) to Rayleigh (coherent) scattering (Inc/coh) that can be used as an indicator of sediment organic matter content. The measurements extend back to the late 1800s. Ages were estimated using Pb-210 dating and Bayesian age-depth modeling.
dct_subject_sm: Bayesian age model, according to Aquino-López et al. (2018)
X-ray fluorescence core scanner (XRF), Cox Analytical Systems, Itrax
dct_title_s: Raw X-ray fluorescence core scanning (XRF-CS) data of a sediment core from Lake Los Espinos (Michoacán, Mexico)
